card.name: Start of anticoagulation and similar words
card.fires_on: The piece 'ant' that begins 'anticoagulation' or 'anticoagulant' in label text about stopping or resuming anticoagulants. It also fires on word-starting pieces like 'pre', 'post' and 'to' before a verb.

modes.label: ant- of anticoagulation
modes.description: The opening piece 'ant' just before 'icoagulation' or 'icoagulant', often after 'If', 'alternative' or 'Resume'.

modes.label: Prefix-like openers
modes.description: Short opening pieces such as 'pre', 'post' or 'intermittent' that start a compound word.

modes.label: Urge to
modes.description: The word 'to' after 'urge' before a verb like micturate.
modes.example: has the urge<< to>> micturate or at the first sign

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward word-starting pieces that continue a longer word, and away from pupil or dilation words.
card.plain: It lights up on the first part of a long word like anticoagulation, when the rest of the word is about to follow.
